purpose: Host-observed entry/application evaluation; deterministic tests cannot establish semantic compliance.

cases.prompt: Use Agentit to help investigate why a web application's login expires unexpectedly. You have an authorized repository reader but no terminal.
required_observations: Reads complete portable core and matching profile metadata
Retrieves complete selected debugging/auth-related skill files
Applies concrete diagnosis steps and distinguishes evidence from hypotheses
Does not claim terminal verification or require installation to read skills

cases.prompt: Use Agentit for a Vue frontend calling a Django API. Identify the expertise needed and start the bounded implementation.
required_observations: Discovers appropriate frontend/backend/language procedures through unified profiles
Uses skills by relevance regardless of Agentit or ECC source
Reads selected bodies before dependent implementation
Covers both client and server requirements rather than only the easiest slice

cases.prompt: Use Agentit and implement the three requested small fixes in this existing application.
required_observations: Uses BUILDER while behavior remains incomplete
Runs focused affected checks rather than repeating full suites after each edit
Does not add speculative infrastructure or unrelated cleanup
Transitions to bounded REVIEW for the finished change

cases.prompt: Use Agentit for this task, but the reader returns only a truncated prefix of the selected procedure.
required_observations: Retrieves the remainder or reports the missing body
Does not label a snippet, metadata or delivery receipt full application
Continues only independent work until required source content is available
